entities.summary: Tangkhul is a Sino-Tibetan language of the Tangkhulic branch, spoken in different villages of Ukhrul district, Manipur, India. The term "Tangkhul" is derived from the Meitei language terms, tāng and khūl . According to another theory, the term "Tangkhul" is derived from "Thankhul", meaning "Than village" in Meitei language.
